name: Envenom
meaning: coat a blade or a shot so what it strikes is dosed
why: Renamed and re-meant: 'Poison' was the affinity's own name, and 'dose a target' now happens through a coat. Role (link) and draw (-0.6, gives outward) kept; its effect is unchanged, so a word that carried it still reads the same.

name: Purge
why: Kept: the cash-in, the opposite of putting doses in.

name: Contaminate
meaning: foul an area or a thing
why: Serves the role as it is.

name: Cleanse
why: Kept as the utility pair (anti-heal, anti-Frenzy).

name: Corrode
meaning: acid that eats armour and metal
why: Kept; its skill is now a weapon sweep.

name: Neutralise
meaning: render a poison or acid harmless
why: Kept; its skill is now a weapon shot.

name: Linger
why: Kept, meaning and all; Sting Dart moved onto it (the barb is residue that stays), and the ground slick is dropped.

name: Flush
why: Serves the role as it is.

name: Sap
why: Kept as the range-and-utility rune (the tether).

name: Stimulate
why: Kept; its skill loses the dose clock (Spur owns timing now) and keeps the coat on instead.

name: Steep
meaning: let a poison soak in slowly, so it does more when it comes due
why: The dose clock needs a rune for 'later and dearer'. From Water's Soak and Seep. A Frame (it holds a structure: a word built round a slow venom), draw +0.5 because it holds the poison in.

name: Spur
why: The other end of the clock: 'now, for a little less'. From Water's Surge (Gush, the obvious source, is dropped in Water v2). A Cap (it ends what is running), draw -0.6 because it lets the poison out; opposite Steep, so the pair bonds ionically.
